The Blade Commander is a seasoned military leader who has risen through the ranks through tactical brilliance rather than noble birth. They command respect not through title or inheritance, but through demonstrated competence in the art of war. Their strategies are conservative and pragmatic, preferring overwhelming force and careful planning to risky gambits.

This commander may lead garrison forces, mercenary companies, or elite military units. They are often found in fortified positions—castles, border forts, or strategic chokepoints—where their tactical mind can be most effective. While not inherently cruel, they view war through a lens of necessity and may order harsh measures if they believe it will save more lives in the long run.

**Motivations:**
- Protect their charges through superior tactics and discipline
- Minimize casualties while achieving military objectives
- Maintain order and stability in their sphere of influence

**Roleplaying Tips:**
- Speaks in clipped, efficient sentences befitting military discipline
- Shows genuine concern for their troops, even when making hard decisions
- Respects competent adversaries, regardless of which side they fight for
